summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for the Soony launch by analysing the confidential data drops, then building a general agent product (poller, extraction, recheck-and-act, routines) with a polished UI and pitch material.
summary.outcome: Found that the Soony plan's all-ok status hides real shortfalls (art books overbooked by 72,000, 5,600 failed statues, short game card shipment, sleeve revision conflict). Built the polling, anchoring, routines, voice and timeline pieces plus a redesigned main view; the paper check agent and visual identity are still in progress.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored data/ folder (raw/, drops/, img/, notes/); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks; the documented approach is to poll the list and compare SHA-256, because files are replaced under the same name.
The team workflow uses CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; work is claimed via a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md, and work happens on branch jonas/alert-platform (PR #5).

The challenge forbids hardcoding and overfitting; scripts/demo_cards.py originally fixed which document contradicts which PO, which is an attack surface, so a generic papercheck.py module replaces it.

Routine actions must be restricted by type: only communication options may run automatically; re-plans, allocations and orders are never automatic. Relying on the cost text ('none') was a safety gap in _costs_money in routines.py.
Routines are now structured recipes (conditions, steps, fixed brake) compiled to sandboxed code (Monty), which allows automatic flow visualisation.
The Python server on :8000 does not hot-reload and must be restarted to serve new clock and state data.
The pack clock must use the time each packed count was taken, not the file title, otherwise the slack is wrong; edition at-risk is the max over cards, not the sum.

code.finding: _costs_money treated an option as free when its cost text was empty or 'none', letting a routine carry out allocation decisions; fixed by restricting to communication option types.
edition_copies_at_risk takes the maximum of an edition's card figures, and the clock uses packed_as_of timestamps; the 34,800 Standard figure likely ignores the 28,000 Hwaseong cards.
Reads quantities live from the portal but hardcoded document references; supports --reset, which backs up state files and switches routines off.

workflow: Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; the hook log shows turns skipped with 'no files modified'.
Running independent expert and builder subagents in parallel with separate file ownership worked well, though a concurrent edit once caused a transient test failure.
A subagent cross-check of all order confirmations and scans against SAP surfaced discrepancies that a first pass missed.
Poll the portal regularly: five new files arrived within 40 minutes of the first download and changed the risk picture.

friction: The team token was initially empty, which blocked data access with 401 until the user supplied it.
A style-guide page was judged unprofessional by the user, requiring a rework toward a high-fidelity Design artifact.
The timeline shows too much red because of a questionable 34,800 Standard figure.
Dashboard contradictions (header vs cards, duplicate Hwaseong cards, raw part codes) undermined the demo.
The live server did not reload Python, so new clock data did not appear until a restart.
The user was confused by an image-size note that I misread as a user message.
open_items: Finish and verify the generic paper check agent, and make sure it re-finds the Hwaseong, PackRight, statue and art book cases on its own.
Verify or correct the 34,800 Standard shortfall at its source before the timeline declares the line stopped.
Run the visual-identity pass (and choose between identity A and B) across all screens, Routines panel, /d/<id>, login, phone, PWA icon and Teams card.
Wire the UI to show activity[].via and read GET /api/routines/drafts in Routines.tsx and api.ts.
Push 13+ commits on jonas/alert-platform into PR #5 once the user approves.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and send the Karton Nowak art-book order (24h offer) and the Boise reply through the product.
Make the launch deadline, editions and capacity configurable instead of Soony-specific, and align with Akshat before replacing the world map main view.
Decide whether to delete the earlier Claude doc, and update the briefing page with the 14:37 drop.
Run scripts/demo_cards.py --reset shortly before the demo so deadlines are not overdue.
